title: Macworld NY 1999-Noah Wyle imitating Steve Jobs
summary: A short clip from Macworld 1999 in which actor Noah Wyle, who played Steve Jobs in Pirates of Silicon Valley, appears on stage as Jobs at the start of the keynote. Jobs then joins in.
why: HN cites it as a funny piece of Apple history and as evidence of Jobs's showmanship and good humor about his portrayal.

quote.text: Jobs must have liked it somewhat though, otherwise he wouldn't have had Noah Wyle reprise the role in an Apple keynote
